name: Estelle Laurent
source:
Estelle is the head of the scientific departement and the daughter of the mysterious "Master".

Brief information:
Symbol: Ice
Best quality: Prudence
Worst quality: Heartlessness
Main fear: Attachement
The most important thing in life: Control
Flower: Orchid
Musical instrument: Violin

"Feelings are irrelevant. Give it up if you don't want to experience even more pain".

[From from in-game character profile]
